hero.headline: Ask us anything about Medicare. There are no dumb questions here.
hero.sub: Most Medicare mistakes don't come from carelessness — they come from people afraid to ask. We sit down with you, or the person you care for, answer every question in plain English, and help you choose coverage you actually understand before a deadline makes the choice for you.

trips.label: How we help
trips.title: Medicare help, sized to your question
trips.note: From one quick question to a full plan review — whether you're turning 65, leaving an employer plan, or on Medicare through disability before 65.

report.label: Free checklist
report.title: The Medicare questions worth asking — before December 7
report.blurb: A one-page checklist of the questions we hear most, in the order to ask them: which doctors and prescriptions to check first, Medigap or Medicare Advantage, what changes if you're still working at 65, and the enrollment deadlines that carry lifelong penalties. Then one short email a week through Open Enrollment, answering the questions people were afraid to ask.
report.note: One email a week. Unsubscribe in one click. We never share or sell your address.
